findings.description: The KMS key used to encrypt the audit trail bucket does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so the key material is never automatically rotated. CIS AWS Foundations requires rotation to be enabled for customer-managed keys, and long-lived key material increases exposure if it is ever compromised.

No policy is defined for this customer-managed key, so AWS applies the default key policy which delegates full key control to the account root and any IAM principal with KMS permissions. For a key protecting audit trail data, an explicit least-privilege key policy should restrict who can use, administer, or schedule deletion of the key.
